## Definition of Done (ROADMAP §23)

- [ ] Typed, lint-clean, self-reviewed
- [ ] Tests at the right levels; CI green
- [ ] Contracts (Zod / OpenAPI / events) updated and generated artifacts committed
- [ ] Authorization verified (IDOR harness covers new endpoints)
- [ ] Privacy reviewed (Appendix E + Privacy Center updated if new data is collected)
- [ ] Logs/metrics for new paths; errors reach Sentry
- [ ] Degraded-dependency behaviour defined (Redis / Kafka / ML / AI down)
- [ ] UI: accessibility checks; loading, empty and error states
- [ ] Docs updated (README / ADR / runbook)
- [ ] Risky change behind a feature flag
